note: P5c (spec §2.8): per-item estimates from the online calibration (V2 and after): b, a (2PL review at >= 500 responses), a testlet's PCM steps, sec (the measured limit: pilot 90th percentile + 20 %), status pretest|operational. Empty at launch: every item's prior b is its b. Written by the offline recalibration from scripts/cat/export-calibration.ts's output, never by hand.
